title: DeadDropDetailsResource link-format leaks private drop IDs
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py
Perspective: security

DeadDropDetailsResource.get_resources_as_linkheader() (lines 499-503)
iterates self._deaddrop._drop_order with no _drop_visible() check
and emits </{id}>;ct="112" for every drop, including privacy=private
and privacy=group.

Evidence: after POSTing a private drop, get_resources_as_linkheader()
includes that drop id next to public ids.

aiocoap PathCapable uses this for child discovery / link-format.
Drop IDs are 24-bit hex. Publishing them lets any client GET
/deaddrop/{id} and observe 4.03 vs 4.04, confirming a restricted
drop exists. Href is /{id} not /deaddrop/{id}.

Acceptance: link-format MUST NOT list private/group drop IDs to
unauthenticated callers. Prefer not advertising child ids at all
(clients already get Location-Path on create).
close_reason: Fix already in place: get_resources_as_linkheader() returns empty LinkFormat([]) at lines 693-699 with SECURITY comment. Test test_dynamic_discovery_is_auth_independent_and_cache_stable verifies behavior.
